regions.name: Huánuco & Central Peruvian Andes
regions.description: Inter-Andean agricultural valleys, high-altitude grassland punas, and montane cloud forests (Yungas/Rupa-Rupa) in central Peru.
regions.typical_fire_regime: Seasonal agricultural clearing (roza y quema) & high-altitude Andean grassland (pajonal) fires escaping during El Niño drought episodes

regions.name: Southern Amazon Basin (MAP Frontier)
regions.description: Madre de Dios (Peru), Acre, and Rondônia (Brazil) tri-border deforestation and tropical forest-frontier hotspot corridor.
regions.typical_fire_regime: Tropical deforestation slash-and-burn & drought-driven understory forest wildfires

regions.name: Paraná River Delta & Gran Chaco
regions.description: Riparian wetlands of the Paraná River Delta and adjacent Gran Chaco dry woodlands (CONAE & Paraguayan Space Agency regional context).
regions.typical_fire_regime: Wetland pasture burning & severe low-water floodplain crisis fires (2020-2022)

regions.name: California Sierra & Coastal Ranges
regions.description: Coniferous Sierra Nevada montane forests and Northern California chaparral-coastal ranges subject to extreme late-summer crown megafires.
regions.typical_fire_regime: High-intensity crown megafires (FRP > 80 MW) with sustained nocturnal persistence

regions.name: New South Wales Eucalyptus Forest Belt
regions.description: Southeastern Australian sclerophyll eucalyptus forests and Blue Mountains ranges characterized by intense austral summer bushfire seasons.
regions.typical_fire_regime: Austral summer eucalyptus bushfires & severe canopy megafires (2019-2020 Black Summer)
